name: novel-plan
do: btn("Grand plan").click(); await w(600);

name: novel-plots
do: btn("Plots").click(); await w(600);

name: novel-scratchpad
do: btn("Scratchpad").click(); await w(900);

name: writer
do: await w(300); btn("✎ Write", document.querySelector("main")).click(); await w(2200);

name: writer-callout
do: await w(300); btn("✎ Write", document.querySelector("main")).click(); await w(2200); $(".writer .be-render")?.scrollIntoView({block:"center"}); await w(800);

name: writer-find
do: await w(300); btn("✎ Write", document.querySelector("main")).click(); await w(2200); const f = $(".writer-find input"); type(f, "lamp"); await w(400); f.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", {key:"Enter", bubbles:true})); await w(500);

name: note-blocks-edit
do: $("main button[aria-label='Edit Calendar']").click(); await w(900);

name: drawer-note
do: [...document.querySelectorAll("main table a[href^='#/note/']")].find(a => a.textContent.includes("Signal Lantern")).click(); await w(1500);

name: drawer-lookup
do: btn("Lookup", document.querySelector(".drawer-side")).click(); await w(500); type($(".lookup input[type=search]"), "lantern"); await w(1500);

name: drawer-datastore
do: btn("Data store", document.querySelector(".drawer-side")).click(); await w(500); [...document.querySelectorAll(".drawer-pane:not([hidden]) .browse-toggle")].find(b => b.textContent.includes("Items")).click(); await w(500);

name: drawer-novel
do: btn("Novel", document.querySelector(".drawer-side")).click(); await w(1500);

name: map-floor
do: $(".tool-opts")?.remove();

name: map-region
do: $(".tool-opts")?.remove();

name: world-export
do: btn("Export world").click(); await w(500); $(".export-linked input").click(); await w(1500);

name: import-check
do: type($(".import-source input"), "https://github.com/TheRealWolfick/novel-craft-data"); await w(200); btn("Check").click(); await w(6000);

name: map-assets
do: $(".tool-opts")?.remove();

name: callout-designer
do: [...document.querySelectorAll(".co-nav .co-type")].find(b => b.textContent.includes("Journal")).click(); await w(1200);

name: stats-template-levels
do: btn("Stats", document.querySelector("main .tabs")).click(); await w(1500); $$(".field-summary").find(b => b.textContent.includes("Step"))?.click(); await w(700); $$(".field-row:not(.folded)")[0]?.scrollIntoView({block:"center"}); await w(500);

name: taxonomy-add-levels
do: btn("Add several").click(); await w(400); type($(".taxonomy-modal textarea"), "Inferno (Low, High)\n\tLow = 1500\n\tHigh = 2200"); await w(500);

name: stats-entry-levels
do: await w(1800); $(".stat-lines")?.scrollIntoView({block:"start"}); await w(400);
